scores.tell: Peach floor and red-orange gradient wall are warm and slightly muddy. The grey legs add little accent. The green seat is good, but the whole card leans warm and the floor chroma is low.

Many hue families (pink, green, yellow, blue, aqua). The saturation is uniformly high, with little neutral to rest the eye. The pale pavement helps, and the overall palette is close to the real cards.
Blue sky, sand and red form a clean complementary scheme. The white dish gives a neutral. Slight warm sand mass, but it is believable.
Orange signs against a blue sky is a classic real-card pairing. The pink butterfly is a single accent. The wood is slightly uniform orange.
Purple background with an orange drink and teal umbrella. The background is a heavy purple field and the colors are fairly loud. The pink straw adds a fourth hue. Reads a little garish.
Yellow background with a grey saucer and green dome is clean and typical of real cards. The orange lights are small accents. The grey is slightly cool and flat.
A mostly green scene with a few small accents. The stone is a muted neutral, which is good. The green field is slightly dull and everything has similar chroma.
Purple rays, orange wood and teal water make a rich palette. The blue water against the orange hull has good contrast. The hue count is high but the ship is coherent.
Blue door with an orange frame and bow, plus pink flowers. The palette is saturated throughout and the warm cream wall is a neutral. Many hue families, but it is close to the real swing card.
Dusty blue-grey gravestone against an orange and yellow backdrop. The hero is low chroma and cool, and it looks pasted on. The gradient background has a muddy feel.
